claim_text: Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-La.) said the executive order altering the childhood vaccine schedule is based on "crazy, stupid" claims and is why Trump's poll numbers are falling.
quote: Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-La.) on Sunday said President Trump's executive order that seeks to alter the childhood vaccine schedule is based on "crazy, stupid" claims, and that they are "why the president's poll numbers are going down."
confidence_justification: An identified sitting senator asserting a characterisation on the record in a broadcast interview; the utterance is well attested across four outlets in the cluster, but the assessment is his, not an established fact. At the news ceiling.
